scope: Refresh source-pinned DWG/DXF 3D carrier, peer release, transform, and downstream consumer boundaries against the current implementation plan.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus local plan and receipt cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md and DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md already separate explicit geometry, raw modeler carriers, AcDs association, B-rep semantics, and native consumer evidence.

The current optional-comparator plan already records GDAL block expansion and its per-block feature cap; this pass verifies the current source and adds an explicit transform/attribute/profile binding.
Existing peer candidate records already classify acis-core, cq-acis, CADKernel, ACadSharp, and LibreDWG by route stage; no new implementation owner was justified.
method.evidenceRule: Mutable source and issue pages describe only their current visible state. Source-code path presence, release notes, issue reproductions, and unmerged PRs are not interchangeable with a pinned runtime result; carrier transport, transforms, B-rep semantics, and selected-consumer acceptance remain separate evidence grades.

evidence.topic: GDAL raw ASM route and transform/options contract
evidence.observed: Current stable docs state binary DXF reading from GDAL 3.12; DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASM and a 12-value column-major transform only for AC1027+ and does not create OGR solids. Modeler entities are skipped by default. INSERT expansion defaults on, per-block feature limit defaults to 10000, ATTRIB maps to TEXT, ATTDEF handling varies with inline-block mode, and output is AC2004 DXF.
doesNotEstablish: full block-owner or attribute graph closure under default options
that a returned transform has been correctly composed with INSERT or entity transforms
evidence.planUse: Use separate explicit-geometry and raw-ASM profiles. For graph checks disable inlining/merge, bind the feature limit and attribute behavior, and record source transform and returned matrix separately; do not apply a transform twice or treat a capped result as complete.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD DWG converter and selected DXF importer boundary
evidence.observed: FreeCAD documentation describes its native C++ DXF importer/exporter as feature-incomplete and DWG conversion as an external converter followed by the ordinary DXF importer; the chosen importer/backend is a separate route dimension.
doesNotEstablish: runtime feature acceptance for any untested release/platform/importer tuple
evidence.planUse: Retain exact converter, output DXF, importer, open/insert, OS and app build identity for each optional consumer row; keep converter handoff distinct from geometry acceptance.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp release versus unmerged writer branch
evidence.observed: The latest formal release shown is signed v3.8.0 at commit 3a1c66b, whose release note adds assembly visibility; the release page shows 150 commits on master since. PR #1240 remains open, describes DXF serialization for Region/CadBody/Solid3D, and depends on #1174.
doesNotEstablish: that the PR implementation is complete or accepted by a CAD consumer
a libdxfrw defect from ACadSharp's issue #1195
evidence.planUse: Do not count the open branch as a comparator pass. A future released route requires a new exact tag and independent read/write, block-only-solid, diagnostic, and consumer checks.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG AcDs parser presence versus reliable owner/body resolution
evidence.observed: Current master contains read_2007_section_acds and acds_private parsing for AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b. Issue #1411 remains open and names a 0.14.8593 reproducer; LibreDWG NEWS describes AcDs/SAB extraction as not yet reliable in its documented history.
doesNotEstablish: that current master is still affected by the exact old reproducer
that current master fixed the reported loss
valid solid geometry or target-consumer acceptance
evidence.planUse: Do not infer fixed/unfixed behavior from issue age or reader-function presence. Any optional run binds an exact commit/build and compares the full per-owner link chain and payload digest, including empty-body negatives.

evidence.topic: No new independent end-to-end ACIS route found
evidence.observed: CADKernel's detailed SAT/SAB matrix remains unsupported/planned despite its broad format headline. acis-core reads bare payloads without producing kernel solids; cq-acis converts supported payload geometry via CadQuery/OCCT, sharing the kernel family with FreeCAD. None adds DWG/DXF/AcDs ownership decoding plus an independent kernel/consumer chain.
doesNotEstablish: semantic correctness of current payload decoders beyond their declared profiles
independence of parser lineage from kernel lineage
evidence.planUse: Retain existing optional payload-only gates and the research stop rule; add no new peer implementation dependency or discovery task absent a primary-source change that fills a named gap.
